risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantitatively detailed, reporting revenue, expense, cash flow, debt/liquidity and operating drivers. Key risks include seasonality, reduced operating cash flow, materially higher bad-debt expense, regulatory inquiries, legal costs and reliance on discretionary capital allocation. Management remains moderately confident in liquidity, but this conclusion is qualified by unexpected developments and other standard forward-looking caveats.
